title: Never Answer In The First Ten Minutes
hook: NEVER ANSWER IN THE FIRST 10 MINUTES

steps.hook: Never answer anything in the first ten minutes.
steps.curiosity: This one habit is why calm people always win.
steps.build: Anger lasts minutes. Words last years. The message you send angry is written by a version of you that won't exist tomorrow. A calm mind sees what emotion can't: the trap, the exit, the truth.
steps.payoff: So before you hit send... breathe. Let the storm pass. Then speak — once.
